description: Documents the specific error scenario of API-026 (Create Clinical History) where registrationId does not reference an existing registration belonging to the patient. Same endpoint as API-026, isolated here to preserve the original docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx functionality numbering.
validation: registrationId, when provided, must reference an existing patient_registrations row belonging to the patient (patient_clinical_history.registration_id FK)

success.status_definition: N/A - this functionality ID documents only the failure path; see API-026 for the success contract

errors.condition: registrationId does not reference an existing registration
